query:
SELECT pi.imageType, pi.imageUrl, pi.caption, p.coverImageUrl
FROM projectImages pi
JOIN projects p ON pi.projectId = p.id
WHERE p.slug = 'red-bull-jukebox'
ORDER BY pi.imageType;
